hero.title: Next‑generation particle accelerator
hero.subtitle: Strategic infrastructure for civil industry, defense and research excellence

civil.title: Civil pathway
civil.intro: Solutions for industry, healthcare and energy, with traceability, safety and optimized total cost.
civil.body: Our accelerator provides calibrated workflows for sterilization, surface activation, materials characterization and full traceability. The modular architecture integrates into industrial lines with predictive maintenance and real‑time monitoring.

defense.title: Defense pathway
defense.intro: Dual‑use capabilities for testing, sensor calibration, CBRN protection and critical infrastructure security.
bullets: Testing of materials and protective shielding
defense.body: The platform supports controlled‑risk operational scenarios, signature generation for sensors and resilience assessments. The toolset enables traceability, audit and integration with command‑and‑control infrastructures.

applications.title: Applications
applications.intro: Modular, scalable portfolio for industrial, clinical and special‑mission workflows.
applications.body: From sterilization to advanced materials processing and isotope production, modules can be tuned for high throughput or highest precision, with an optimized total cost of ownership.

research.title: Research
research.intro: Open platform for university partnerships and consortia, with access to data and experimental facilities.
research.body: We provide reproducible infrastructure for experiments, data access and publication support. We collaborate on multi‑year programs and technology transfer to industry.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Tell us your objectives. We provide technical advisory and a tailored roadmap.
